meta.scope: Only models referenced by catalog/usecases.yaml. Rebuild the full registry locally with the scripts in registry/scripts.

or_models.license_note: OpenRouter public API (no key). Factual price/capability data; the API docs state no open license for /models or /endpoints, so values are used as attributed facts per p0ssess DESIGN.md. Do not mirror wholesale.

or_endpoints.url: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/{canonical_slug}/endpoints (per model, the API's own links.details path)
